observations.seen: A warm low sun sits near the horizon at the left with a pink-to-gold gradient sky. The key light reads as backlit sunset rather than the 3/4-front daylight sun the recipe asks for. The ball has a clear specular highlight and shading, and the gates are lit consistently.
The ball casts a soft contact shadow under itself. The gate frames cast offset shadows onto the track in frames 1 and 2. The pillars and floating islands show no visible cast shadows on the clouds.

The track shows faint mirrored copies of the gates, which reads as a planar or screen-space reflection. The ball and the rail beads have glossy highlights, but the reflections are a single white blob with no visible environment reflection of the sky colors.

The scene has floating grass islands with towers, hot-air balloons, wooden pillars with pointed tops, bunting flags, and a cloud sea. The world is varied and coherent, though the repeated pillars fill much of the mid-ground.

Distance haze softens the far pillars and islands toward pink. Speed lines radiate from the vanishing point. The fog is heavier and more tinted than the light daylight fog of 0.0025 the recipe specifies.

Most surfaces are flat toon-shaded with dark outlines. The wood track carries only a faint plank texture with streaky marks. The pillars are untextured brown. The paint-splat decals behind the ball are flat red blobs with no wetness or shading.

The foreground clouds are chunky faceted low-poly shapes with hard banded shading, which look rough next to the smoother ball and gates. The pillars are plain boxes with pyramid tops. The islands, towers, and balloons are simple but readable.

The track's converging rails make strong leading lines to the vanishing point. The ball sits low, and in frame 4 it is about 60 px wide, well under the 18–25% subject target. Large foreground clouds and bunting at the frame edges compete with the play area.

The camera is a high behind-the-ball chase view looking down the track, not the side-on follow the recipe specifies. The field of view looks wider than 50°, which shrinks the ball and stretches the foreground clouds.

A bright bloom glow washes out the center of the track around the far gates and lowers contrast there. Color grading pushes everything toward pink and lavender. No daylight-outdoor grade is visible. Edges look reasonably anti-aliased.

The hearts, a power bar, and the score and combo panels in the top right share a consistent cream rounded-card style with dark outlines. The 2x 5s pill appears under the ball. The title card has clear instructions and accessibility toggles. Everything is legible and does not cover the track.
